x: Dear Alan, I hope you don't mind an outsider entering your Crossword-Contest but I thought that if as many Belgravians entered for it as contested the Surrey Senior Cross-Country, you'd be a rather Cross-Man when you came to mark up the entries.

(although we won't refuse if you want to give some more) why not write out a cheque now to Belgrave Harriers and send it to the Editors at [address withheld]. Alternatively you can give cash to Alan or Charlie when you next see them.
When organiser Dave Denton acknowledged the entry he couldn't help adding the note: "Potentially the winning team, Alan - if you can get them all out!"
